Funnel Runners RU v0.1.16
=========================
mderick.dev

Tested on game patch from 2026-09-04 (Steam buildid 25107874).
Higher / newer game builds may not work.

UNSUPPORTED. Source: use however you want.

Install: extract RELEASE zip, run Install.bat
Uninstall: Uninstall.bat

Includes:
- String Tables (FunnelRunners_RU_P)
- UI pack (FunnelRunners_RU_UI_P)
- World textures (FunnelRunners_RU_TX_P)
- Fonts via StormEscape-Windows.pak (backup -> .bak_ru)

After Steam Verify game files, run Install.bat again.
